requirements.title: Test Article Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the Century Spring test blog article according to reviewer feedback, including stronger storytelling introductions, while treating the approximately 1,000-word target as flexible rather than a hard limit.
requirements.boundary_note: Storytelling, added content, and word-count flexibility are acceptance attributes of the same revised article deliverable. Linked reviewer comments may contain additional criteria, but their contents are unavailable.

requirements.title: Landing Page Copy Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the copy on the identified existing landing page according to section-specific directions supplied in the forthcoming brief.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a separate deliverable from the test article and can be assigned, revised, and accepted independently. Rates, effort estimates, deadlines, and anticipated monthly assignment volume are project-management facts and are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The linked article comments and suggested edits are not present in the supplied history and may contain additional independently meaningful acceptance criteria that cannot be safely recovered.
